scope: Microphone conversation with application window already open

checks: compiled App plays first audio before complete provider response
measured start under five seconds with controlled 150 ms AI / 100 ms TTS fixtures
timing history is reachable from the stopwatch and records a single turn
Escape cancels pending server generation and logs cancellation
failed request stays in history instead of disappearing from measurements
next question responds after cancellation and failure, without a stale lock
AudioWorklet manual send includes actual ASR and endpoint delay in the same question timer
one receipt ID follows actual microphone bytes through recognition, AI, Fish response and playback
ASR failure is recorded even when no chat request can be sent
same recording is resent after ASR failure, its actual transcript reaches AI and the answer reaches TTS
13-second recognition completes and reaches real audio playback instead of being aborted at the old 12-second deadline
9-second synthesis finishes with audible playback instead of being killed by the former 8-second voice deadline
TTS failure keeps the open Language panel unchanged, retains the error past final AI metadata, and only opens written cards when requested
native audio leaves transcription state on handoff, receives its recognized question and speaks before final metadata
native answer failure preserves the actual recognized question for retry, without redundant ASR or the voice placeholder
diagnostic button submits a fresh arithmetic question and plays the computed answer using the same backend and TTS path
diagnostic stays copyable when the embedded browser does not provide clipboard permission
open-window microphone ASR reaches AI and the identical complete response is read by controlled device voice when online TTS fails; no panel popup or closure
10-second online synthesis hedge reads the actual answer locally and a late online completion does not restart speech
hung AudioContext activation is bounded and reads the same response through device speech instead of leaving generating forever
Escape cancels active device speech without replaying a queued continuation or changing to another voice
browser.environment: Chromium + compiled UI + real local FastAPI/HTTP + real SSE parser and WAV playback; external AI and TTS controlled, synthetic microphone, controlled ASR/AI/TTS, no physical Windows microphone/speaker validation

scenarios: Missing saved output with unsupported sink API: WAV playback
Missing saved output: real PCM playback with default output
Muted volume: no synthesis or playback, explicit explanation
